summary: Explains inventory merging (specific overrides generic), footnotes on role defaults visibility, vars plugins and cacheable set_fact, that later definitions within a section win, and that this assumes hash_behaviour=replace.
questions: If two groups define the same variable, which one wins?
Do tasks outside a role see that role's defaults?

answer_card.title: Precedence details and hash_behaviour
answer_card.answer_md:
- Inventory merges so more specific settings win (a host_var `ansible_user` beats a group_var `ansible_ssh_user`).
- Tasks in a role see their own role's defaults; tasks outside a role see the last role's defaults.
- `set_fact` with `cacheable` has high precedence in the play, but host-fact precedence when loaded from cache.
- Within a section, the last definition wins (e.g. the last group loaded, or the second entry in `vars:`).
- This all assumes `hash_behaviour=replace`; `merge` overwrites only partially.
